actions.title: List saved servers
actions.summary: Lists the SSH servers saved in the Net panel, and whether each is connected. Never returns passwords or keys.

id.description: Stable id; always unambiguous as a 'server' argument

name.description: Display name; also accepted as a 'server' argument

connected.description: Whether a session is open right now

actions.title: List a folder on a server
actions.summary: Lists the entries of a remote folder over SFTP: name, type, size, modification time and permissions.

server.description: Saved server id or name (see net.servers.list)

path.description: Folder to list. Absolute, or relative to the login folder; '~' or omitted means the login folder

limit.description: Most entries to return, by name order

modified.description: ISO-8601 instant, or null when unknown

permissions.description: As ls shows them, e.g. rwxr-xr-x

actions.title: Read a file on a server
actions.summary: Reads a remote file over SFTP. Text comes back as UTF-8, anything else as base64.

server.description: Saved server id or name (see net.servers.list)

path.description: File to read. Absolute, or relative to the login folder

maxBytes.description: Most bytes to read from the start of the file

size.description: The file's full size in bytes

truncated.description: True when the file is longer than what was read

actions.title: Run a command on a server
actions.summary: Runs a shell command on a saved SSH server, without a terminal, and returns its exit code and output.

server.description: Saved server id or name (see net.servers.list)

command.description: Shell command line, run by the login shell. Must not wait for input

cwd.description: Folder to run in. Absolute, or relative to the login folder; omitted means the login folder

timeoutSeconds.description: The command is stopped after this long

exitCode.description: The command's exit status; -1 when it was stopped

stdout.description: Standard output; only the last 256 KB when longer

stderr.description: Standard error; only the last 256 KB when longer

truncated.description: True when earlier output was left out of stdout or stderr

actions.title: Write a file on a server
actions.summary: Creates or replaces a remote file with the given content. Replacing an existing file is shown to the user as a diff for approval first.

server.description: Saved server id or name (see net.servers.list)

path.description: File to write. Absolute, or relative to the login folder

encoding.description: How 'content' is encoded; base64 for binary files

created.description: True when the file did not exist before

unchanged.description: True when the file already had exactly this content; nothing was written

actions.title: Copy between servers
actions.summary: Copies a file or folder from one saved server to another (or within one), streaming through Commander. The content is never returned to the caller.

fromPath.description: File or folder to copy. Absolute, or relative to the login folder

toServer.description: Destination server id or name; may be the same server

toPath.description: The copy's exact path: the new file's path, or the folder the source folder's contents go into

overwrite.description: Replace files that already exist at the destination (the user is asked first)

skippedSymlinks.description: Symbolic links inside a folder are not copied
